dedupe_keys.name: blue green indicators and green space networking layer for climate adaptation in hesse wms

description: This web map service publishes the blue-green infrastructure indicators of a climate adaptation analysis covering the whole German state of Hesse, with a sub-layer on green space networking (Grünraumvernetzung). According to the ministry's service description, the wider analysis of the current situation covers temperature patterns (universal hot and cold spots), land use such as the degree of soil sealing, and blue-green infrastructure indicators, alongside population density, vulnerable uses and the resulting spatial priorities for climate adaptation across Hesse. It is produced by the Hessian Ministry for Economics, Energy, Transport, Housing and Rural Areas and is accessible as an INSPIRE view service through the Hessen geoportal, which the data.europa.eu catalogue lists as last modified in April 2026. The service's licence is the Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0), with attribution to the ministry. Caveats: this entry is a WMS map view of one indicator group, not downloadable vector or raster data, the indicator definitions are not given in the capabilities document, and the companion heat and population layers sit in other services. It supports climate adaptation planning and hazard exposure screening for heat and green space provision at state scale; a related record is the Vienna Urban Heat Vulnerability Index.
